_about: Every piece of text the app shows. Edit the words freely; keep {placeholders} exactly as written. 'one' / 'other' pairs are singular / plural. designSystem.text and designSystem.patterns translate text drawn by the Parlor design system's own components (card names, the rules sheet, settings, rule messages): the key is the design system's English wording, the value is what to show. Page titles and the installed app's name live under pages and app; the build copies app.* into manifest.webmanifest.

Build down, alternating red and black.
text.Foundations build up by suit, ace to kin: Foundations build up by suit, ace to king.
text.Move all 52 cards to the four foundation: Move all 52 cards to the four foundations, one per suit, from ace up to king.
text.Every card is dealt face up into eight c: Every card is dealt face up into eight columns. Top left are four free cells; top right, four foundations.
text.Move the last card of any column, or a c: Move the last card of any column, or a card from a free cell.
text.Onto a column: one rank lower and the op: Onto a column: one rank lower and the opposite color, like a red 7 on a black 8.
text.Into a free cell: any single card. Each: Into a free cell: any single card. Each cell holds one.
text.Into an empty column: any card, or a run: Into an empty column: any card, or a run of cards.
text.Runs move as a unit if there is room to: Runs move as a unit if there is room to shuffle them through: (free cells + 1) × 2 for each empty column.
text.Free cells are precious. Fill one only w: Free cells are precious. Fill one only when it opens up something better.
text.An empty column is worth more than a fre: An empty column is worth more than a free cell.
text.Deals are numbered, so a friend can play: Deals are numbered, so a friend can play the same one. Nearly every deal can be solved — of the classic 32,000, only #11982 cannot.
text.Auto fills the table. Smaller sizes leav: Auto fills the table. Smaller sizes leave room around it.
text.Large index makes ranks easier to read o: Large index makes ranks easier to read on phones.
text.Safe moves only cards nothing else can u: Safe moves only cards nothing else can use.
text.Free cells move to the right, foundation: Free cells move to the right, foundations to the left.
text.Moves as many cards as your free spaces: Moves as many cards as your free spaces allow.

replay.title: Replay
replay.lockedBody: You haven’t solved this one yet. The replay shows every move, so it gives the deal away.
replay.solvedBody: You’ve already solved this deal, so the replay opens straight away. Compare how you each got there.
replay.linkKeeps: The link keeps working. Solve it first and the replay opens straight away.
replay.confirmToday: Today won’t count toward your streak. You can still solve it afterwards: it counts as Solved and shows as “Watched first” in your calendar.
replay.confirmPast: This day can’t join your streak any more, so nothing is lost. If you solve it later it counts as Solved, marked “Watched first”.
replay.restartStep: Restart: back to the first layout
replay.takeOver: Take over at this point. It’s practice, so it won’t count.
replay.broken: This replay link is damaged or from a newer Parlor.
replay.brokenHelp: Ask for the link again, or check that it was copied in full.
replay.notThisDeal: This replay doesn’t match its deal, so it can’t be shown.
